name: nightshift
description: Keeps a Claude Code session working while you're away: answers its own questions, settles permission prompts, and checks in every 15 minutes.

everyMinutes.title: Check-in interval (minutes)
everyMinutes.description: How long the session may sit idle before nightshift checks in.

stallMinutes.title: Stall limit (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: A turn with no activity for this long is stopped and restarted.

maxReviews.title: Strict reviews per goal
maxReviews.description: How many times a "done" claim is reviewed against the goal and sent back before nightshift accepts it.

reviewNotes.title: How you check work
reviewNotes.description: Your own bar, given to the reviewer and to Claude, e.g. "screenshot and compare with the mock; run the game; read copy out loud".

budget.title: Money rules
budget.description: What Claude may spend while you're away. Empty uses the default: free options first; cloud GPUs only when nothing free works, at most $0.60 an hour, no storage volumes, shut down right after each run.

extraDeny.title: Extra deny patterns
extraDeny.description: Regular expressions, one per line or separated by ;;, for commands nightshift must never approve.
